requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures SOPs are established, implemented and maintained for all administrative and technical laboratory operations.

mappings.quote: The quality manager should ensure the establishment, implementation and maintenance of standard operating procedures for all administrative and technical operations

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for personnel matters, including qualifications and training.

mappings.quote: personnel matters, including qualiﬁcations and training

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for control of documents, records and data integrity.

mappings.quote: control of documents, records and data integrity

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for corrective and preventive actions.

mappings.quote: corrective and preventive actions

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for purchase and receipt of supplies such as reagents and materials.

mappings.quote: purchase and receipt of consignments of supplies (for example, reagents and materials)

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for procurement, preparation and control of reference substances and materials.

mappings.quote: procurement, preparation and control of reference substances and reference materials

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for equipment qualification, including calibration.

mappings.quote: qualiﬁcation of equipment, including calibration

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for preventive maintenance and verification of instruments and equipment.

mappings.quote: preventive maintenance and veriﬁcation of instruments and equipment

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for internal labelling and storage of materials and solutions.

mappings.quote: internal labelling and storage of materials and solutions

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for sampling, where the laboratory performs it.

mappings.quote: sampling, if performed by the laboratory

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for sample testing, describing the methods and equipment used.

mappings.quote: testing of samples with descriptions of the methods and equipment used

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for validation and verification of analytical procedures.

mappings.quote: validation and verification of analytical procedures

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for validity of test results.

mappings.quote: validity of test results

mappings.quote: atypical and out-of-specification results

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for risks and opportunities.

mappings.quote: risks and opportunities

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for cleaning of laboratory facilities, including bench tops, equipment, workstations, aseptic clean rooms and glassware.

mappings.quote: cleaning of laboratory facilities, including bench tops, equipment, workstations, clean rooms (aseptic suites) and glassware

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for monitoring of environmental conditions such as temperature and humidity.

mappings.quote: monitoring of environmental conditions (for example, temperature and humidity)

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for monitoring of storage conditions.

mappings.quote: monitoring of storage conditions

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures an SOP is in place for disposal of reagents, standards and samples.

mappings.quote: disposal of reagents, standards and samples

requirements.item_text: The laboratory director ensures that certificates of analysis, analytical test reports and other important reports and protocols are approved.

mappings.quote: the certiﬁcates of analysis, analytical test reports and other important reports and protocols are approved

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures the laboratory takes part regularly in suitable proficiency testing schemes and, where possible and applicable, collaborative studies.

mappings.quote: the laboratory participates regularly in suitable proﬁciency testing schemes and, whenever possible, collaborative studies (as applicable)

requirements.item_text: The quality manager ensures due arrangements for safekeeping and control of poisons and narcotic, psychotropic and radioactive substances, which are kept locked up and handled and used only in designated places under an authorised person's supervision.

mappings.quote: due arrangements are made for the safekeeping and control of substances that are subject to poison regulation or to the controls applied to narcotic, psychotropic and radioactive substances, and which should be stored under lock and key, and handled and used in designated places under the supervision of an authorized person

requirements.item_text: Where the excipient manufacturer claims in specifications, labels or a drug master file that an excipient is pyrogen free, the manufacturer ensures that it is.

mappings.quote: The excipient manufacturer is responsible for ensuring that excipients are pyrogen free if the manufacturer makes such a representation in specifications, labels or a drug master file.
